description: This Java source file defines the 'IncomingMessageInterstitial' activity class in an Android application. It provides an interstitial UI for notifications related to incoming messages and handles user interaction to switch to the main app activity.

classes.name: IncomingMessageInterstitial
classes.description: An Android activity that shows an interstitial UI when a notification related to incoming messages is received. It provides a button to switch to the main app activity that displays the message.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the UI, and attaches a click listener to the button to handle user interaction.

methods.name: switchToApp
methods.description: Handles the transition to the main application activity when the user interacts with the button.
